plain: Light-mode dividers and hairlines are darker warm graphite (border.default #cbc6c9, border.strong #b2abae) so they read on soft surfaces; no code change needed.

steps.plain: --semantic-color-border-default (role.border, border-border) is now graphite.200 #cbc6c9 in light, up from #e5e5e5; if you override it, keep it at 1.45:1 or more on your surfaces.
--semantic-color-border-strong is now graphite.300 #b2abae in light, up from #d4d4d4, so strong dividers and Kbd edges stay firmer than border.default.
--semantic-color-border-subdued (deprecated) follows border.default in light at #cbc6c9; move to border.default.
